text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mm, I'm just feeling kind of restless.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My heart and legs are itching to go, 
eagerly awaiting that moment.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—It's starting. The ultimate time of 
freedom, where nobody can stop me or hold 
me down!
